name: Frequency Granularity Type 1 Code
definition: Defines the granularity of the frequency used for the reporting.

EMON.name: End Of Month
EMON.definition: Event takes place at the end of each month or period of one month.

EWEK.name: End Of Week
EWEK.definition: Event takes place at the end of each week.

ESEM.name: End Of Semester
ESEM.definition: Event takes place at the end of each six months (or two times a year).

EQRT.name: End Of Quarter
EQRT.definition: Event takes place at the end of each period of three months (or four times a year).

EFRT.name: End Of Fortnight
EFRT.definition: Event takes place at the end of each two weeks.

EDAY.name: End Of Day
EDAY.definition: Event takes place at the end of each day.

ENDY.name: End Of Year
ENDY.definition: Event takes place at the end of each year.
